employeeInputs.source: Form MO W-4A or MO W-4C

steps: Annualize gross taxable wages using the prescribed payroll-period multiplier.
Subtract the filing-status standard deduction; do not reduce taxable income below zero.
Accumulate tax through every applicable annual bracket.
Divide annual tax by payroll periods, round to the nearest whole dollar, and add any MO W-4 line 2 amount.

supplementalWages.combinedWithRegularWages: Apply the ordinary formula to the combined payment.
separatelyPaidMethods: Aggregate supplemental and regular wages for the payroll period, then subtract tax already withheld from regular wages

residencyAndWorkRules.nonresidentMultiState: Compute withholding on total federal wages, then multiply by Missouri-source wages divided by total federal wages; Form MO W-4A documents the allocation.
residencyAndWorkRules.residentWorkingInAnotherState: A Missouri employer withholds the difference when the work state's requirement is lower than Missouri's, unless the employee files Form MO W-4C and assumes responsibility.
residencyAndWorkRules.interstateRailAndMotorCarrierRule: Withhold only in the employee's state of residence for regularly assigned multistate duties.
residencyAndWorkRules.airAndWaterCarrierRule: Withholding is limited to residence and any different state where more than 50% of wages are earned.

frequencies.trigger: Withheld at least $9,000 per month in at least two of the preceding 12 months
frequencies.paymentDue: Within three banking days after periods ending the 7th, 15th, 22nd, and last day of each month

frequencies.trigger: Withheld at least $500 per month in at least two of the preceding 12 months
frequencies.due: 15th of following month; quarter-end months due last day of following month

frequencies.trigger: Not monthly and withheld at least $100 in at least one of the preceding four quarters
frequencies.due: Last day of month following quarter

frequencies.trigger: Withheld less than $100 in each of the preceding four quarters

captureWarnings: The Department's separately maintained final administrative-rule PDF indexed during capture describes $20 quarterly/annual thresholds, while the exact 2026 Employer's Tax Guide and current business guidance use $100. This capture follows the 2026 guide but preserves the conflict as an activation blocker.
The resident-other-state difference method requires both states' actual payroll withholding and a valid MO W-4C branch.
Complete wage-bracket matrices are retained in the checksummed guide but are not transcribed.

review.requiredNextStep: Obtain an agency determination of the $20-versus-$100 filing-frequency conflict, import wage-bracket matrices, and add bracket-boundary, allocation, resident-credit, rounding, and supplemental regression tests.
